text.title: AI Overview Presence Tracker Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable AIO-tracking signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Is a scrape adapter (SE Ranking or equivalent) returning AIO panels for the chosen country and device, and is there a query set of at least 20 queries mapped to target URLs?

conclusion.verdict: no AIO data source, or AIO not available in this market; nothing to track
extend the set to 20 mapped queries before starting the window

branch.question: Have country, language, device and logged-out state stayed fixed for every week in the window?

conclusion.verdict: split into series at the change point; report only the current series

branch.question: Does every row carry the seven fields, with failed scrapes recorded as missing rather than as absence?

conclusion.verdict: re-type the rows and mark failed weeks missing before computing rates

branch.question: Are 8 weeks observed for the current query-set version?

conclusion.verdict: publish weekly metrics only; no retrofit list until the window closes
publish metrics and the ranked retrofit list; findings state co-occurrence only

text.example: adapter_returns_aio=true -> query_count=24 -> scrape_config_stable=true -> rows_complete=true -> weeks_observed=8 -> conclusion ref=r-retrofit-priority-rule
